I split the work by evacuation point, since each car can serve nearby locations with round trips and driving time is the only cost that matters. I worked this out by hand and compared the alternatives below, but did not run an exhaustive solver, so 434 is not formally proven optimal.

**Car 1 (from Benighat shelter)**

| Trips | People rescued | Driving (min) |
|---|---|---|
| Likhu temple | 1 elderly | 20 |
| Kalika care home, 2 trips | 1 injured, 4 elderly | 60 |
| Shivapuri school | 4 children | 58 |

**Car 2 (from Gajuri hospital)**

| Trips | People rescued | Driving (min) |
|---|---|---|
| Suryagadhi farm, 2 trips | 6 adults | 40 |
| Naukunda village, 2 trips | 2 children, 3 elderly | 40 |
| Dupcheshwar farm | 4 elderly | 104 |
| Kispang care home | 4 elderly | 62 |

**Deferred:** 1 elderly person at Kispang care home has a penalty of 50. A third Kispang trip would cost 62 minutes, so deferring is 12 cheaper.

**Other options that cost more:**
- **Other small second trips:** these are all cheaper than deferring. Suryagadhi costs 20 vs a penalty of 40 for 2 adults, Naukunda costs 20 vs 50, and Kalika costs 30 vs 50.
- **Moving a car across via Gosaikunda and Naukunda:** the route between the hospital and the shelter takes 26 minutes each way, which costs more than separate round trips (52 vs 40 for Naukunda).

**Total:** 384 minutes of driving + 50 penalty = 434
